pending.preview.open: Preview browser (apps/server/src/preview/*): needs a headless browser host or the desktop browser channel; server side not ported.

partial.device.configure: Remote SSH device hosts are stored, and device.testHost probes them over SSH (ssh_device_host.rs), but the device service has the one local host: a remote host is never connected to, listed or opened.
partial.server.getConfig: OTLP export is not ported (the otlp*Enabled flags are false), and the local trace file holds the spans browsers exported but none of the server's own (trace_sink.rs). directEndpoints and remoteOpenTargets are served (environment_endpoints.rs).

pending.GET /api/preview-stream/*: Preview browser frame stream: not ported.
pending.POST /api/preview-stream/upload: Preview browser file upload: not ported.

pending.html_preview: Listed; fails as the original's HTML renderer does without a browser.
pending.html_render: Listed; fails as the original's HTML renderer does without a browser (htmlRender/headlessChrome.ts not ported).

clientOnly.addProjectBaseDirectory: The original's server never reads it (clients do).
clientOnly.pullRequestMergeMethod: A project-scoped key the clients resolve; the original's server only lists it among the project-scoped keys.
clientOnly.projectAutoPullOverrides: A derived view of projectSettingsOverrides, maintained by the settings model (server_settings_model.rs).
clientOnly.projectAgentBrowserAccessOverrides: A derived view of projectSettingsOverrides, maintained by the settings model (server_settings_model.rs).
